finding.description: Every default easy bank uses [I, 1/I, I², x, x²]. The correct exponential is uniquely the one whose doubled exponent also appears, allowing the learner to ignore the ODE.
finding.reproduction: Run /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python reproduce_failures.py; expected exit 1. Minimal case: generate('easy', seed=8173, template='signed_constant_power', parameters={'a':'1','n':2}). For y′+y=x², the factors exp(x), exp(-x), exp(2x), x and x² reveal exp(x) from the bank alone. The opposite-sign paired case also succeeds.
finding.requested_change: Change the complete-bank construction rule shared by all three easy templates so superficial exponent relationships cannot identify the key independently of P. Preserve legitimate coefficient variation and unique correctness; retain the conditional shortcut regression.

finding.description: Canonical source e-21741, y′+2y=2exp(-2x), cannot be generated. Constant-P templates permit only cosine or polynomial forcing; exponential-forcing templates require nonconstant P.
finding.reproduction: Run /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python canonical_coverage.py; expected exit 1. All 12 reachable easy forcing assignments at P=2 are retained in canonical-candidates.json; none matches the canonical equation.
finding.requested_change: Support the canonical constant-coefficient exponential-forcing family through the normal construction path, deriving the prompt, integrating factor, choices and worked solution together.

reason.summary: Two demonstrated defects: easy answer banks reveal the correct factor without reading the ODE, and the canonical source case is unreachable. Three stored generated questions are affected. Package unchanged; no database writes.

source_analysis.skill: Transform a first-order linear ODE into d(yI)/dx = IQ using an integrating factor.
reasoning_steps: Normalize the derivative coefficient and identify P and Q.
Recognize the product derivative and select the complete transformed equation.
invariants: I is nonzero on the working interval and satisfies I′ = PI.
Multiply the normalized Q by the same I.
Stop before solving for y; retain the single-choice response contract.
permitted_variations: Vary small coefficients, signs, forcing functions and source-supported normalization.
Vary correct positions and distractor relationships without making the answer recognizable from the bank alone.

source_replay.details: All eight practice banks and 40 choices replayed, with source gaps and corrections documented. The canonical exponential-forcing example is unreachable.

math.details: Independent printed-equation checks verified unique correct choices and multiplication/final solution equations for 44 records.

variety.details: Coefficients and positions vary, but every easy bank assigns the correct factor the same recognizable exponent relationship. Canonical forcing coverage is also missing.

scope.details: Requested easy outputs preserve the source reasoning stages, prerequisites and response workload.

grading.details: Native grade_field produced the expected 71 acceptances and 176 rejections across 44 records, including shortcut-selected answers.

rendering.details: Six actual-UI screenshots passed renderer checks and visual inspection, including relevant sign changes and irrelevant choice permutations.

packaging.details: Exact dependency versions, deterministic replay, invalid-input rejection and relocation verified. Package hashes remain unchanged.

decision_variation.details: A bank-only strategy succeeds on 24/24 fresh easy samples, 8/8 within each easy template, 5/5 runner inputs and 4/4 delivered survivors. Three stored generated easy instances reproduce the defect. Selection scenarios and captured-inventory limits are documented.
